title: S7 Canonical ReviewResult
description: The single structured result one Assignment submits (L3-S7 §3.5). claim_results must equal the Assignment's Claim set exactly; every fail Claim references a Finding with a real encounter. Submitted via `loop-harness runtime review-result submit`.

assignment_revision.description: The ReviewPlan/Assignment revision observed before execution; stale revisions are not submittable.

subject_digest.description: sha256 over the ReviewPlan's frozen_subjects (sorted path:sha256 lines). The submit verb recomputes and rejects drift.

verification_artifact_digest.description: E2E cold_start only: digest of the spec/fixture/evidence revision actually used. Null when no verification workspace exists.

claim_results.description: The pass/fail answers. Together with blocked_claims this must equal the Assignment's Claim set exactly — no missing entries, no extras, no Claim answered twice. not_applicable is a ReviewPlan disposition, never a Reviewer conclusion.

observed.description: What the Reviewer actually observed for this Claim.

blocked_claims.description: Required Claims the Reviewer objectively cannot execute because a confirmed product Finding of this round breaks a build/start/entry/precondition (L3-S7 §3.5 blocked_by_confirmed_finding). The tool projects these to disposition=blocked; they are never a pass and never satisfy the repaired round's Claim. Token/time/Agent shortage has no confirmed Finding to bind and is rejected.

blocking_finding_ids.description: Confirmed Findings of this review round (consumed earlier or confirmed by this same result) that make the Claim non-executable.

after_repair_required.description: Invariant: the repaired round owes this Claim a real execution.

site_lost.description: Explicit Reviewer declarations that an ordinary Finding's encounter scene is unrecoverable (L3-S7 §9.1 step 12). When the named Finding also fails investigation readiness, submit records an Assignment BLOCKER and stays in S7 instead of consuming the result; P0/security/data-destructive findings never use this path (they seal with capture_gaps).

findings.description: One Finding per fail Claim, each with a real encounter (see finding.schema.json).

verdict.description: Use 'finding' for blocked Claims (with findings[]), 'pass' for all pass, 'req_change_required' / 'release_blocked' for human-pause verdicts. 'fail' is not a valid verdict — there is no per-Claim verdict that maps to it; submit verdict=finding with findings[] populated (one Finding per fail Claim, each with a real encounter).

then.description: verdict=finding needs at least one Finding with a real encounter, or a blocked_by_confirmed_finding projection bound to a confirmed Finding of this round.

allOf.description: Every Claim is answered exactly once: at least one of claim_results / blocked_claims must be non-empty (an Assignment whose Claims are all blocked still submits one result).
